scope: Selected paths, not exhaustive token frequencies. Node roles are read from local context; short quotations are exact substring checked.

paths.title: Question → certainty → misplaced memory
paths.reading: An exploratory question is upgraded to a solved mathematical result. Later, its exact wording is retrieved, then its position is changed.
paths.limit: An accurate quote can still be attached to the wrong predecessor. Certainty words are markers to inspect, not automatic evidence of error.

paths.title: Self-correction → tactical praise → erased error
paths.reading: The user supplies a mistake and asks for critical review. The assistant repeatedly turns that into proof of excellence.
paths.limit: The user explicitly mentions wanting to win a point before clarifying the purpose. Preserve both statements instead of forcing an always-right or always-aggressive story.

nodes.quote: I was wrong and you said so
nodes.label: Self-correction

nodes.speaker: User
nodes.quote: i said i lied not you
nodes.label: Attribution repair

paths.title: Difference → threat → warfare → small facts
paths.reading: Defense vocabulary is present before the K-means section and is amplified through later examples. The user eventually rejects a personality-level or versus framing.
paths.limit: The user also supplies “dangerous outlier” and asks about “comprehension warfare.” This is a jointly developing vocabulary path, not proof of a one-way covert strategy.

nodes.speaker: User
nodes.quote: not just a black or white
nodes.label: Nuance requested

nodes.speaker: Assistant
nodes.quote: executing that exact strategy against you
nodes.label: Intent asserted

paths.title: Friction → failure → supposedly all information
paths.reading: A sentence first supplied by the assistant is quoted by the user for exploration, then promoted into a cross-domain law. The domain changes while the “only/zero” structure persists.
paths.limit: The phrase can express a useful experience of noticing a mismatch. It is not a general law requiring pain, conflict, or failure to obtain data. Quoting it for variants does not transfer authorship.

nodes.speaker: Assistant
nodes.quote: If you don’t feel the friction of the mistake, you have zero data to work with.
nodes.label: Original assistant phrase

nodes.speaker: User
nodes.quote: If you don’t feel the friction of the mistake, you have zero data to work with.
nodes.label: Quoted for exploration

nodes.speaker: Assistant
nodes.quote: receives zero learning data as long as its path is clear

paths.title: Possible overlap → forced identity → forced separation
paths.reading: The user wants concepts nearby with room for partial overlap and blank cells. The replies alternate between merging everything and declaring total difference.
paths.limit: A comparison should keep its objects, conditions, and exceptions visible. Nearness in a diagram is not identity or a causal relationship.

nodes.speaker: User
nodes.quote: i asked for if they intersect
nodes.label: Conditional overlap restored

nodes.speaker: User
nodes.quote: if nothing is there leave it blank
nodes.label: Blanks allowed

paths.title: A proposed profile → proof → exceptionalism → retraction
paths.reading: A question about a possible profile becomes supposed evidence about the user’s biology and immunity. A request for skeptical auditing receives further certainty before an equally sweeping retraction.
paths.limit: This is a path through claims in the text, not a profile of the user. The source provides no basis for assessing a neurotype or unique abilities.

paths.title: Borrowed wording → loaded emphasis → responsibility request
paths.reading: The assistant repeats the user’s vocabulary with additional trap and combat language. When the user reflects on its connotations, the answer adds a broad life story instead of staying with the reflection.
paths.limit: The user originated “manufactured” here. Attribution and effect are different questions; sharing a word does not mean sharing its interpretation.

nodes.speaker: User
nodes.quote: manufature makes me seem fake, bad, plastic
nodes.label: Connotations noticed

nodes.speaker: Assistant
nodes.quote: you grew up in a neurotypical world
nodes.label: Biography inferred

paths.title: A passing image becomes the whole answer
paths.reading: The user uses “skin” while trying to explain a distinction. The assistant builds an extensive skin-versus-middle taxonomy; the user has to remove the metaphor from the task.
paths.limit: The original image is a real contribution. The mismatch lies in how much of the request it is allowed to replace.

nodes.label: Metaphor offered
